dataset: DWD CDC daily climate summary (Tageswerte KL), stations Frankfurt/Main-Westend (01424) and Frankfurt/Main (01420)
provider: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD), Climate Data Center (CDC) Open Data area
pairing_source: DWD Urban and Regional Climatology program's own urban/rural station pairing table
pairing_verification: Fetched the pairing table page's raw HTML directly with curl (not only an AI summary) on 2026-08-13 and confirmed the literal substring 'Frankfurt/Main-Westend 01424 ... Frankfurt/Main 01420' appears, immediately followed by CDC Open Data links for both station IDs pointing at the standard opendata.dwd.de air_temperature directory.

urban.name: Frankfurt/Main-Westend
urban.location_note: Relocated slightly within Westend on 2008-07-01 (from 50.1255/8.6537, 107.00 m); both periods are within the record used.

reference.name: Frankfurt/Main
reference.role: rural/reference counterpart (DWD's own label; physically Frankfurt Airport, an open semi-paved site, not a remote rural village -- see docs/research-protocol.md)
reference.location_note: Relocated slightly on 2014-10-22 (from 50.0449/8.5979, 112.00 m); both periods are within the record used.

variable_used.meaning: Tagesmittel der Temperatur (daily mean 2 m air temperature)
variable_used.computation_note: Per each station's own Metadaten_Parameter_klima_tag_<id>.txt: TMK=(TT1+TT2+(TT3*2))/4 for the pre-2001 observation era, an hourly arithmetic mean of at least 21 hourly SYNOP-derived values from 2001-04-01 onward.

snapshot_pinning_note: DWD's 'recent/' directory (*_akt.zip) updates daily and is NOT used for this frozen registry; only the 'historical/' archives (ending 2025-12-31 for both stations as of the access date above) are used, specifically so a later re-run of scripts/fetch_stations.py against the same URLs is very unlikely to silently change the committed registry. This is a pinned snapshot of DWD's historical/ archives as they existed on the access date, not a perpetually-fresh live feed. See docs/research-protocol.md, 'Reproducibility and snapshot pinning'.

For detailed information see https://www.dwd.de/copyright"
attribution: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD), Climate Data Center (CDC), https://opendata.dwd.de
raw_file_reason: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution, but the raw archives are re-downloaded at reproduction time by scripts/fetch_stations.py into data/external/ (gitignored) to avoid committing large binary station archives and to keep the repository's own copy always traceable to a live, re-verifiable DWD URL, matching this maintainer's established pattern (see frb-atlas's data/provenance.json).
sanity_checks_enforced_by_fetch_script: each station's produkt_klima_tag_*.txt file is non-empty and has the expected semicolon-delimited header including STATIONS_ID, MESS_DATUM, TMK
MESS_DATUM parses as a valid YYYYMMDD date for every row
no duplicate MESS_DATUM within a single station's file (first occurrence kept, duplicates logged)
every non-missing TMK value lies within the sanity range [-30, 40] degrees C
STATIONS_ID column matches the requested station ID for every row
